highlights: Invite new customers to get started: a guided, ten-minute set of questions in their language fills their organization with locations, contacts, devices and documents, marked as customer-provided — with optional encrypted login details and an optional passkey sign-in
Locked passwords stay locked: only tenant administrators and explicitly entrusted people can change their permissions or unlock them, and they can no longer be used through shared credentials
Every uploaded file is checked before it is released and cannot be swapped unnoticed afterwards; private SSL keys in PEM format are stored encrypted
